masters.classroom: A cinematic wide film still, shot on Kodak Vision3 film. An empty Taiwanese elementary school classroom on a bright morning: a large green chalkboard with nothing written on it on the front wall, rows of simple wooden desks and chairs (a few pushed aside to open a space at the front), a row of large windows along the LEFT wall with warm sunlight streaming in and soft light beams, a small black guitar amplifier on the floor near the front. Warm amber and soft teal grade, realistic, clean.
masters.classroom_dusk: A cinematic wide film still. The same empty Taiwanese elementary school classroom at sunset: green blank chalkboard, wooden desks with chairs pushed in, large windows on the LEFT wall with thin white curtains drifting, deep orange-gold sunset light raking across the desks. Nostalgic, quiet, realistic.
masters.rooftop: A cinematic wide film still. The flat concrete rooftop of a Taiwanese elementary school on a clear sunny morning: a waist-high concrete parapet with a metal railing, a small black guitar amplifier with a cable, blue sky with soft clouds, and beyond the railing a generic Taiwanese city skyline of mid-rise apartment blocks and green hills in the distance (no famous landmark, no skyscraper tower). Bright, fresh, realistic.
masters.rooftop_dusk: A cinematic wide film still. The same flat concrete school rooftop at golden-hour sunset: concrete parapet with metal railing, a small black guitar amplifier, the sun low on the horizon, orange-pink sky, and beyond the railing a generic Taiwanese city skyline of mid-rise apartment blocks and green hills in the distance (no famous landmark, no skyscraper tower) in silhouette. Warm backlight, realistic.
masters.stage: A cinematic wide film still. The stage of a Taiwanese elementary school auditorium during a student concert: a wooden stage floor, deep red velvet curtains at the sides, a drum kit at the back, two large black guitar amplifiers, two microphone stands at the front, colorful stage spotlights (warm amber, blue, magenta) cutting through light haze. Energetic concert lighting, realistic, no people.
masters.hall: A cinematic wide film still taken from the edge of a school auditorium stage looking out at the audience area: rows of folding chairs on a wooden floor, a high ceiling with hanging lights, warm haze lit by stage spotlights from behind the camera. Empty, no people, realistic.
masters.field: A cinematic wide film still. A Taiwanese elementary school sports field on a sunny day: a red running track with white lane lines around green grass, a big shady banyan tree at one side, a basketball hoop, and a three-story school building with long open corridors in the background. Bright, realistic, no people.
masters.bleachers_dusk: A cinematic wide film still. Low concrete bleacher steps beside a school running track at sunset: red track, green field, goal posts, the sun setting over a generic Taiwanese city skyline of mid-rise apartment blocks and green hills in the distance (no famous landmark, no skyscraper tower), warm golden light and long shadows. Nostalgic, realistic, no people.
masters.corridor: A cinematic wide film still. A long open-air corridor of a Taiwanese elementary school: classroom doors and windows on one side, a low wall with green plants on the other side open to the courtyard, terrazzo floor, soft daylight. Realistic, no people.
